name: Battle of Mosul

sides.name: Iraq and coalition
sides.strength: Iraqi Army, Counter-Terrorism Service, Federal Police, Peshmerga, US-led air support; about 100,000
sides.casualties: About 8,200 Iraqi security forces and Peshmerga killed; civilian dead in the thousands

sides.name: Islamic State
sides.casualties: Nearly all killed; a few hundred surrendered

summary: Mosul was the largest city held by the Islamic State and the place where al-Baghdadi declared the caliphate in 2014. The Iraqi army's counter-offensive, supported by Kurdish Peshmerga and US-led coalition air power, took nine months. The Old City was reduced to rubble by the time it fell.
significance: Mosul was the end of the territorial caliphate as a state-shaped thing. Modern urban warfare on a scale not seen since the Second World War, fought block by block with drones, tunnels, and improvised armour. The reconstruction is still incomplete.
